Namespaces.Name: Output
Namespaces.Doc: Options that configure the behavior of the primary audio output device.

Namespaces.Name: iOS
Namespaces.Doc: Runtime options specific to the iOS family of platforms (iOS, tvOS, visionOS).

Options.Name: EnableAVAudioEngine
Options.Doc:
Allow using AVAudioEngine API when the operating system supports it (iOS/tvOS 13 and above).

When AVAudioEngine is enabled and available, 3D Audio can be used on iOS/tvOS via Apple Spatial Audio technology.

For visionOS, AVAudioEngine is always enabled and 3D Audio is always available.

Options.Name: AudioSession_Category
Options.Doc:
Determines app-level audio behaviours such as inter-app audio mixing policies and audio routing behaviours.

These values are funtionally equivalent to the corresponding constants defined by the iOS audio session service backend (AVAudioSession). See Xcode documentation for details on the audio session categories.

Options.Name: AudioSession_MixWithOthers
Options.Doc:
Corresponds to AVAudioSessionCategoryOptionMixWithOthers.

Only affects PlayAndRecord and Playback categories.

Options.Name: AudioSession_DuckOthers
Options.Doc:
Corresponds to AVAudioSessionCategoryOptionDuckOthers.

Implicitely sets the MixWithOthers option. Only affects PlayAndRecord and Playback categories.

Options.Name: AudioSession_AllowBluetooth
Options.Doc:
Corresponds to AVAudioSessionCategoryOptionAllowBluetooth.

Only affects PlayAndRecord category.

Options.Name: AudioSession_DefaultToSpeaker
Options.Doc:
Corresponds to AVAudioSessionCategoryOptionDefaultToSpeaker.

Only affects PlayAndRecord category.

Options.Name: AudioSession_AllowBluetoothA2DP
Options.Doc:
Corresponds to AVAudioSessionCategoryOptionAllowBluetoothA2DP.

Only affects PlayAndRecord category.

Options.Name: AudioSession_Mode
Options.Doc:
Determines the specialized behavior of the chosen audio session category.

These IDs are functionally equivalent to the corresponding constants defined by the iOS audio session service backend (AVAudioSession). See Xcode documentation for details on the audio session modes.

Options.Name: AudioSession_RouteSharingPolicy
Options.Doc:
Determines whether audio should be routed to somewhere other than the default system output.

The route-sharing policy only applies to the Playback audio session category.

Options.Name: AudioSession_NotifyOthersOnDeactivation
Options.DisplayName: Audio Session: Notify Others on De-activation
Options.Doc:
Dictates whether the operating system should notify other apps when the Wwise audio session is de-activated.

Corresponds to AVAudioSessionSetActiveOptionNotifyOthersOnDeactivation.

Options.Name: AudioSession_SuspendWhenInactive
Options.Doc:
Dictates whether the Sound Engine should be automatically suspended when the app goes in the background. 

This option only applies when using audio categories that allow playing audio in the background (PlayAndRecord or Playback).

When true, Wwise automatically calls Suspend when the app becomes inactive (UIApplicationWillResignActiveNotification) and WakeupFromSuspend when the app becomes active (UIApplicationDidBecomeActiveNotification).

When false, Wwise does not react to these notifications. Audio will keep playing when the app is in the background.

Options.Name: AudioCallbacks
Options.Doc: Callbacks for interfacing with audio-related events. Must be a pointer to an AkAudioCallbacks instance.
